title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre on 1982-10-09
source: Sony ECM-220T mics > Sony TC-D5M > DAT > CDR

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear audience recording of a fire‑filled Frost ’82 show, highlighted by a monster Estimated→Eyes jam.
ai_review.review: The performance is uniformly stellar – a long, tight first set with Alabama and Greatest kicking things off and a second set that never dips, featuring the legendary Stones > Touch > Estimated > Eyes sequence.  The audience (AUD) source is praised as one of the best ever – crisp, balanced, and front‑center Bob Weir guitar, though drums can be a touch recessed without EQ.  Overall the band is described as “in the zone” and the show still gives listeners goosebumps.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for both musical performance and recording quality across >15 detailed reviews; minor drum‑level issues do not detract from the overall excellence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear balance with front‑center Bob Weir guitar; slight lack of drum definition noted by some listeners who recommend EQ boosts on low/mid frequencies.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Uniformly strong first set followed by a solid second set with no appreciable let‑down; seamless transitions especially into the jam-heavy Estimated/Eyes sequence.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as “on fire”, remembered lyrics perfectly and delivering a rousing U.S. Blues opener.
band_member_comments.Phil: Slightly less definition in the mix, but overall solid bass foundation noted.
band_member_comments.Bob: Guitar is front‑and‑center throughout; many listeners highlight his playing during the show.
band_member_comments.Drums: Some reviewers note drums are recessed and benefit from EQ boosts; otherwise no major complaints.
